attributes.board_name: Mississippi Board of Examiners for Social Workers and Marriage & Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Only programs/activities approved by the board's MFT Continuing Education Committee (listed on the board website); SW approvals do not carry over; academic courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal period.

topics.who: Approved MFT professional ethics (max 2 via distance/self-directed)
Board-approved supervisors incl. AAMFT Approved Supervisors (not at first renewal after approval)

rules.notes: Up to 12 of the 24 hours may be distance learning/online. 2-year license period; renewal date not confirmed.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Title 30, Part 1903, Rule 4.1
